rows.name: Franjo "Frajno" Kosina
rows.relation: possible brother of Pavao Kosina, unplaced
rows.citation: CEMLA, Buenos Aires port arrivals - "KOSINA FRAJNO, 47, C, CROATA (HRVATSKA), AGRONOMO, 1947/04/01, PHILIPPA, GENOVA". FRAJNO is FRANJO; born about 1900, married, an AGRONOMIST. He sailed from Genoa on the SAME SHIP as Oskar Kosina six months before him. Martin Kozina and Angjelika Boras had sons in 1891 and 1894 and she died in 1902, so a son born about 1900 is possible and NOT established. Nothing joins him to the tree

rows.name: Gerko Kosina
rows.relation: unplaced, head of a family of six
rows.citation: CEMLA - "KOSINA GERKO, 30, C, AUSTRIACO - DALMATA, PRIVATO, 1911/04/10, SOFIA HOHENBERG, TRIESTE", with CLARA 25 and four children: ANKA 4, IRMA 4, OJESKOSLAIO 2 and GELKA 0. GERKO is JERKO and OJESKOSLAIO is VJEKOSLAV; the two four-year-olds are twins or one age is wrong. Croatian given names, Austrian-Adriatic nationality, sailing from Trieste. NOT joined to this family and there is nothing but the surname

rows.name: Ivan Kosina
rows.relation: unplaced, NOT Oskar's son
rows.citation: CEMLA - "KOSINA IVAN, 27, S, YUGOSLAVA/S.H.S., VELIC, AGRICULTOR, 1928/11/30, GRAL. BELGRANO, HAMBURGO". Born about 1901 and single. He is NOT Ivan Christian, Oskar's son, who was born in Argentina after October 1947 - the archive checked because the names collide

rows.name: Gertraud "Gertruda" Kosina
rows.relation: MOTHER OF MARTIN KOZINA - not in the tree at all
rows.citation: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1832-1870, book p.64 - "Gertraud Kosina, hueblnn. Tochter", entered as the ONLY parent of Martin, born and baptised 16 November 1841; THE VATER COLUMN IS BLANK and the tick is in the UNEHELICH column. She is a Haeusler's daughter. In 1836 she stands godmother on the same register (book p.33) as "Gertraud Kosina, Haeuslerstochter". Forty-seven years later the Senj marriage of 12 January 1888 names her again - "Gertruda Kozina, posjednica" - with a dash where Martin's father belongs. TWO REGISTERS, TWO COUNTRIES, THE SAME ABSENCE. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00886, image 65

rows.name: Josef Kosina
rows.relation: Haeusler at Kranj-Smartin, possible father or brother of Gertraud - UNPROVEN
rows.citation: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1832-1870, book p.33 - "Josef Kosina, Haeublnr" with wife "Lucia Labornik", parents of a child baptised 1836 (index entry 55, Johan Kozina). A MARRIED Kosina household in the same small parish in the same decade. Gertraud is entered as a "Haeuslerstochter" and Josef is a Haeusler, so a father-daughter or brother-sister link is LIKELY AND NOT ESTABLISHED. Nothing joins them yet. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00886, image 34

rows.name: Lucia Labornik
rows.relation: wife of Josef Kosina
rows.citation: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1832-1870, book p.33 - entered as mother beside "Josef Kosina, Haeublnr". Matricula, NSAL sig. 00886, image 34
